hero.caption:
Historical part of Porto, a World Heritage Site seen from Vila Nova de Gaia, trough the Douro river.
At the right, the metallic Luiz I (Dom Luís Bridge) with the northern tip of the Infante bridge behind it. At its left, the whole historic center with the Clérigos Tower in the horizon. The plaza in the middle is the Ribeira plaza. In the leftmost part of the picture, the Arrábida bridge. The picture also shows the typical rabelo boats, once used for the transport of Port wine.

images.filename: Rabelos en el río Duero, Vila Nova de Gaia, Portugal, 2012-05-09, DD 14.JPG
images.caption: Rabelos in the Douro River with the city of Porto in the background, Portugal. Rabelos are traditional Portuguese wooden cargo boats used for centuries to transport people and goods from along the Douro River. Wine was brought in rabelos from the interior of the country to Porto, home to many wine cellars.
images.alt: Rabelos in the Douro River with the city of Porto in the background, Portugal. Rabelos are traditional Portuguese wooden cargo boats used for centuries to transport people and goods from along the Douro River. Wine was brought in rabelos from the interior of the country to Porto, home to many wine cellars.
